decisions.reason: The bio-based bitumen binder remains a flagship of the firm's circular-economy direction and growth gives slack to carry it, but it sits far from the core plant business and has shown no clear market traction, so withdrawal risk stays notable.

The mobile mechanical recycling plant extends the core WASTX modular line at low incremental cost and fits the decentralized strategy, so results are unlikely to fall below aspiration enough to trigger search for other uses of its resources.
